blocks.text: Everything you write to an AI is sent to the company's servers. So be careful what you share – just like anywhere online.

items: Other people's private details without permission (health, addresses, phone numbers).

blocks.text: When you need help with a personal document, replace real names and numbers with made-up ones or placeholders ([NAME], [AMOUNT]). The AI needs the structure of the problem, not your real data.
Help me write a complaint to my bank about a transaction of [AMOUNT] that was charged twice on [DATE]. My name is [NAME]. Firm but polite tone.

items: Use only the official apps and websites of the tools.
Watch out for fake apps with a similar name and logo.
AI voices and images can be faked – if someone "urgently" asks you for money, check by calling them yourself.
Nobody from the company will ask for your password in the chat.

blocks.text: At work: before you upload work documents, check your company's rules on using AI.
In Claude's settings you can check whether your chats are used to improve the models and turn that off.
ChatGPT has a temporary chat that isn't saved in your history, and a setting so your chats aren't used for training.
In your Google account you can control whether your Gemini activity is saved and for how long.
